# Surviving mutants accepted on purpose (ADR 0101).
#
# One line per mutant: <file>:<line>:<column> <MUTATOR> <reason>
#
# <file> is relative to the repository root, <MUTATOR> is the type gremlins
# prints (CONDITIONALS_BOUNDARY, CONDITIONALS_NEGATION, ARITHMETIC_BASE,
# INCREMENT_DECREMENT, INVERT_NEGATIVES, ...). The reason is required: name
# why the mutated code behaves the same (an equivalent mutant) or why a test
# for it is not worth its cost. An accepted mutant does not count against the
# package's floor. A line that no longer matches a surviving mutant (the code
# moved or a test now kills it) is reported by the run, so delete it.
#
# Example:
# internal/retention/janitor.go:352:8 CONDITIONALS_BOUNDARY the cutoff is a whole day and never equals a row's timestamp
